XAddiVortes settings

Source: R/xaddivortes.R
xaddivortes_params.Rd

The settings of xaddivortes(), and of the fast start of thiessen(start = "fast"). The defaults are the core's, which xaddivortes_defaults() returns.

Usage

xaddivortes_params(
  rounds = 40,
  max_columns = 3,
  centres = 64,
  value_scale = 0.5,
  replace_share = 0.3
)

Arguments

rounds

Replacement rounds after the build, a whole number from 0. The fit time grows linearly with it; with 0 the build goes straight to the final refit.

max_columns

The most columns of a tessellation, a whole number from 1; capped at the number of columns.

centres

The most centres of a tessellation, drawn at random training rows before empty cells are dropped; fresh tessellations take it or one of its halvings down to 4. A whole number from 1 to 65,535.

value_scale

The share of the shrunk cell mean used as the cell value in the build and the rounds, in (0, 1]; the final refit chooses from it up to 1. Smaller values fit more slowly and overfit less.

replace_share

The share of tessellations replaced each round, in [0, 1]; 0 makes the rounds pure refits.

Value

An object of class "xaddivortes_params".

See also

xaddivortes(), xaddivortes_defaults()

Examples

xaddivortes_params(rounds = 20, max_columns = 2)
#> xaddivortes_params(rounds = 20, max_columns = 2, centres = 64, value_scale = 0.5, replace_share = 0.3)
